    clen, ctype = struct.unpack("<II", f.read(8))
    j = json.loads(f.read(clen))
    blen, btype = struct.unpack("<II", f.read(8))
    blob = f.read(blen)

def get_acc(idx):
    acc = j["accessors"][idx]
    bv = j["bufferViews"][acc["bufferView"]]
    off = bv.get("byteOffset", 0) + acc.get("byteOffset", 0)
    cnt = acc["count"]
    ct = acc["componentType"]
    t = acc["type"]
    ncomp = {"SCALAR":1,"VEC2":2,"VEC3":3,"VEC4":4}[t]
    fmt = {5126:"f", 5123:"H", 5125:"I"}[ct]
    sz = struct.calcsize(fmt)
    stride = bv.get("byteStride", sz * ncomp)
    out = []
    for i in range(cnt):
        out.append(struct.unpack_from("<" + fmt*ncomp, blob, off + i*stride))
    return out

part_ranges = m["glb_part_ranges"]["containment_gate.glb"]
total_area = 0.0
part_areas = []
for mesh_idx, mesh in enumerate(j["meshes"]):
    node_name = j["nodes"][mesh_idx]["name"]
    prim = mesh["primitives"][0]
    pos = get_acc(prim["attributes"]["POSITION"])
    inds = [x[0] for x in get_acc(prim["indices"])]
    for pname, start_tri, n_tris in part_ranges[node_name]:

            cx, cy, cz = uy*vz - uz*vy, uz*vx - ux*vz, ux*vy - uy*vx
